sector.zh: 半导体 · AI 算力平台

disclaimer.en: Prototype — figures illustrative, verify before use
disclaimer.zh: 原型 — 数据仅供示意,使用前请核实

headline.en: NVIDIA is not a chip company — it is the toll booth on AI infrastructure.
headline.zh: 英伟达不是芯片公司 —— 它是 AI 基础设施的收费站。

dek.en: Data Center is ~88% of revenue and the platform (CUDA + systems) is the moat. The debate is durability of pricing, not whether it leads.
dek.zh: 数据中心约占营收 88%,平台(CUDA + 系统)即护城河。分歧在于定价的可持续性,而非是否领先。

viz.sub_zh: 高位持有 · 平台收费

thesis.en: One segment is the company — Data Center ~88% of revenue.
thesis.zh: 一个板块就是整家公司 —— 数据中心约占营收 88%。

thesis.en: Software is the moat — CUDA + systems lock the platform.
thesis.zh: 软件是护城河 —— CUDA + 系统锁定平台。

thesis.en: Underwrite pricing power, not share — share is ~maxed.
thesis.zh: 按定价权而非份额定价 —— 份额已近见顶。

footer.zh: 核心结论 · 一屏论点

headline.en: A parabola that keeps re-basing higher.
headline.zh: 一条不断在更高位重新筑底的抛物线。

dek.en: Every data-center print resets the base. Trend is intact; the only real question is multiple compression risk, not direction.
dek.zh: 每一次数据中心业绩都抬高基准。趋势完好;唯一真问题是估值压缩风险,而非方向。

footer.zh: 示意股价路径 · 动量判读

headline.en: There is one slice. The rest is rounding.
headline.zh: 只有一块。其余都是零头。

dek.en: Data Center dwarfs everything. Gaming is a healthy but irrelevant-to-thesis cash line; ProViz and Auto are optionality.
dek.zh: 数据中心碾压一切。游戏是健康但与逻辑无关的现金流;专业可视化与汽车属于期权价值。

label.zh: 数据中心 — GPU + 系统 + 网络

bullets.en: Data Center +143% YoY — Hopper→Blackwell ramp plus networking attach.
bullets.zh: 数据中心同比 +143% —— Hopper→Blackwell 放量叠加网络配套。

bullets.en: Gaming steady — healthy but ~9% of mix; not a thesis lever.
bullets.zh: 游戏平稳 —— 健康但仅约占 9%;非逻辑杠杆。

bullets.en: Concentration is the risk — one segment, a handful of buyers.
bullets.zh: 集中度即风险 —— 单一板块,少数买家。

bullets.en: Optionality below — ProViz/Auto are call options, not base case.
bullets.zh: 下方是期权 —— 专业可视化/汽车是看涨期权,非基准情形。

footer.zh: 板块结构 · 单引擎集中

headline.en: +$69.6B in one year — almost all of it one segment.
headline.zh: 一年净增 696 亿美元 —— 几乎全部来自一个板块。

dek.en: This is not diversified growth. Data Center alone added ~$68B; the bridge is essentially a single bar.
dek.zh: 这不是多元化增长。仅数据中心就增加约 680 亿美元;增长桥本质上只有一根柱子。

footer.zh: 营收桥 · 单板块增长

headline.zh: 硬件出货量,软件级利润率。

dek.en: Gross margin sits in the mid-70s and operating margin in the low-60s — extraordinary for a hardware vendor and the core of the bull case.
dek.zh: 毛利率维持在 75% 上下,经营利润率在 60% 出头 —— 对硬件厂商而言极为罕见,也是多头逻辑的核心。

callout.en: Read: margins this high invite competition and pricing scrutiny — durability, not level, is the question.
callout.zh: 判读:如此高的利润率会招致竞争与定价审视 —— 问题在可持续性,而非高度。

footer.zh: 利润率轨迹 · 软件化

headline.en: The leader shares the same chokepoints as everyone else.
headline.zh: 领导者与所有人共用同一批咽喉。

dek.en: Design and software are owned; leading-edge capacity, advanced packaging and HBM are rented and industry-constrained.
dek.zh: 设计与软件自有;先进产能、先进封装与 HBM 皆为外租且受全行业约束。

detail.zh: 台积电 — 路线图单一来源。

detail.en: Advanced packaging gates GPU volume directly.
detail.zh: 先进封装直接限制 GPU 出货。
SK 海力士 / 三星 / 美光按配额。

detail.en: A few hyperscalers drive the order book.
detail.zh: 少数云厂商主导订单簿。

detail.en: China rules cap a defined TAM slice.
detail.zh: 对华规则封顶既定市场份额。

headline.en: A 4/5 insulation score: hard to displace, not impossible to erode.
headline.zh: 4/5 的护城河评分:难以替代,但并非不可侵蚀。

dek.en: CUDA + systems make displacement expensive. Erosion comes from in-house silicon and AMD as a credible second source, not a head-on replacement.
dek.zh: CUDA + 系统让替代成本高昂。侵蚀来自自研芯片与作为可信第二供应商的 AMD,而非正面替代。

detail.en: Credible #2; pressures pricing at the margin.
detail.zh: 可信的第二名;边际上压制定价。

detail.en: Gaudi traction limited; not a near threat.
detail.zh: Gaudi 进展有限;非近端威胁。

detail.en: Triton/ROCm chip away at CUDA gravity slowly.
detail.zh: Triton/ROCm 缓慢削弱 CUDA 引力。

footer.zh: 竞争图谱 · 隔离而非无敌

headline.en: Every print is a referendum on demand durability.
headline.zh: 每次业绩都是对需求可持续性的公投。

dek.en: The variable under test never changes: is hyperscaler capex still accelerating, or digesting?
dek.zh: 被检验的变量从未改变:云厂商资本开支仍在加速,还是在消化?

note.en: Blackwell ramp + data-center guide are the whole tape.
note.zh: Blackwell 放量与数据中心指引就是全部盘面。
下一代架构与系统路线图。
来自微软/谷歌/亚马逊/Meta 指引的传导。

note.en: China-facing TAM is a recurring swing factor.
note.zh: 面向中国的市场是反复出现的摆动因素。

footer.zh: 时点催化剂 · 未来约 12 个月

headline.en: At this size, the multiple does the heavy lifting.
headline.zh: 在这个体量,估值倍数承担了主要变量。

dek.en: Revenue can keep compounding, but from a $130B base the return is dominated by what multiple the market assigns to durable AI infrastructure.
dek.zh: 营收仍可复利,但从 1300 亿美元基数出发,回报由市场赋予“可持续 AI 基础设施”的倍数主导。

callout.en: Sensitivity: at this scale a 5-turn multiple change swings MoIC more than any plausible revenue beat.
callout.zh: 敏感性:在此体量,5 倍的倍数变化对 MoIC 的影响大于任何合理的营收超预期。

footer.zh: 情景泳道 · 倍数主导

dek.en: This prototype uses illustrative figures. In production every number is null-over-invented and carries the source below.
dek.zh: 本原型使用示意数据。在正式版本中,每个数字“宁缺勿造”,并附下列来源。
